archetypes.name: dyn-tier1a-prose
archetypes.rationale: Tier-1a prose was condensed while preserving pinned behavioral contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the AGENTS.md, KARPATHY_CLAUDE.md, and BASH_AUTHORING.md trims for semantic drift. Pay special attention to anti-polling literals, plan grammar tokens, Bash safety forms, and concrete honesty obligations that must survive prose compression. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-ratchet-wiring
archetypes.rationale: A new lint command is wired into CLI, Makefile, docs, and CI.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the lint tier1a-size integration end to end. Confirm the CLI registry, Makefile targets, lint aggregate, CI step placement, and docs all refer to the same command and do not introduce dependency or harness partition drift. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
